evidence.detail: NpcDefinition, ItemDefinition and SpotAnimationDefinition each own this exact type as their optional definition-driven model override state; item/NPC developer recoloring overlays also consume it directly.
The definition config loaders populate this aggregate from surviving keys including 'opacity', 'recolor/recolors', 'retexture/retextures', 'textures' and 'reshade'.
The aggregate composes ModelRecolorOverride, ModelRetextureOverride and ModelReshadeOverride plus the scalar opacity override and applies all enabled components to one Model.
Its apply(Model) method prepares/applies each configured helper over Model faces and writes the opacity-derived face array when configured; it owns no unrelated definition/gameplay state.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 aggregate for definition-driven Model appearance mutations: opacity, recolor, retexture/texture and reshade.

evidence.detail: NpcDefinitionConfigLoader and ItemDefinitionConfigLoader construct this exact helper for the surviving YAML keys 'recolor' and 'recolors' inside the shared rs/a/b/c model-override aggregate.

The constructor accepts grouped source/destination integer arrays, indexes all source color ids, and the per-face apply path rewrites Model.ar entries that match each source group to the next destination value in that group's configured cycle.
R209 ModelRecoloringOverlay reads this helper's tracked color set while inventorying model colors for the exact 'Recoloring NPC/Item/Object' development surface.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the definition-driven Model face recolor mapping; original stripped identifier is not claimed.

evidence.detail: NpcDefinition and ItemDefinition config loaders route the surviving keys 'retexture'/'retextures' and 'textures' into this exact helper inside ModelAppearanceOverride.

The helper builds source-to-destination integer mappings, tracks affected Model face ids, initializes texture-support arrays/masks and remaps matching face presentation ids while preserving original vertex triplets into texture coordinate arrays.
R209 ModelRecoloringOverlay explicitly unions this helper's tracked source ids and source/destination mapping sets when labeling model entries '(texture)' and '(texturized)'.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for definition-driven Model texture/retexture mapping.

evidence.detail: The class is the abstract common base of the recolor, reshade and retexture helpers and defines one whole-Model preparation hook plus one per-face mutation hook.
Its concrete b(Model) implementation iterates exactly Model.ah face entries and dispatches the per-face override method for each index.
The only exact-v308 subclasses are rs/a/b/a, rs/a/b/d and rs/a/b/e, each populated from model appearance override keys and mutating Model face presentation state.

proposals.note: Conservative base name for the exact per-face Model override contract shared by recolor/reshade/retexture operations.

evidence.detail: NpcDefinition, ItemDefinition and SpotAnimationDefinition config loaders construct this helper specifically from the surviving YAML key 'reshade'.
The helper stores one configured integer and writes that value into Model.ar for every eligible face, skipping faces already marked by the texture/retexture preparation mask.
ModelAppearanceOverride owns this helper as the dedicated reshade component and applies it independently from recolor and retexture operations.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 name fixed by the surviving 'reshade' config key and its per-face Model mutation.
